testCases.title: Visibility: Winner = Brand Name → all engines show Favorable in panel
steps: Given I am on the Visibility tab of a category where the tracked brand wins
When I find a row where the Winner column shows the brand name (e.g., Toyota)
Then the detail panel shows Favorable (green) badge for every active LLM engine

testCases.title: Visibility: Winner = Competitor Name → non-Favorable in panel + competitor is #1 in ranking
steps: Given I am on the Visibility tab of a category where the tracked brand is not ranked #1
When I find a row where the Winner column shows a competitor brand name
Then panel shows Unfavorable or Unranked per engine, and competitor matches #1 in ranking list

testCases.title: Visibility: Winner = "Unranked" badge → all engines show Unranked in panel
steps: Given I am on the Visibility tab where the brand is absent and LLMs disagree on which competitor is #1
When I find a row where the Winner column shows the red "Unranked" badge
Then the detail panel shows Unranked (red, #--) for every active LLM engine

testCases.title: Visibility: Winner = "Split" badge → per-engine mix, "Split" never appears as per-engine label
steps: Given I am on the Visibility tab where LLMs give different tier results for the brand
When I find a row where the Winner column shows the orange "Split" badge
Then each engine independently shows its tier (Favorable/Unfavorable/Unranked) — Split never appears as a per-engine label in the panel
